summary: An event whose supporting message was deleted, or whose person was forgotten, is no longer listed, revised, shown on the portal or announced.
details: Events written by the Cognition session's verbs (which still only record what they would write) now carry the ids they cite, a stated reasoning and a confidence for each field, and an abduced value is kept as a question to ask rather than written as fact.

A withdrawal marks an event whose citations reach the withdrawn message, the way it already marks a note, a room position or a culture account; event_search, a room's event list, the portal and the tag path's event tools read a marked event as unknown, and a due gathering reminder for one is cancelled instead of spoken.
An event written on a tag turn now records the room it was said in, so it no longer reads as having no known source.
limitations: An event written on a tag turn cites no message, so a withdrawal cannot reach it yet.
The Cognition session stays in shadow: nothing it validates is committed, and per-field reasoning is not yet rendered to Nora.
